newsitem.title: USA: Rhone-Poulenc to file on Lyme disease vaccine.
newsitem.headline: Rhone-Poulenc to file on Lyme disease vaccine.

text.p: Pasteur Merieux Connaught, a unit of the Rhone-Poulenc Group said it plans to submit a product license application to the U.S. Food and Drug Administration for its Lyme disease vaccine.

The company also said that it will offer the vaccine to all study participants who received placebo during the trial. The Phase III trial to determine whether the vaccine protected recipients against Lyme disease was completed in March 1996.

The company said the results are promising in terms of efficacy and have prompted it submit the PLA in the next few months. The company added that it will soon offer its vaccine to all participants in the placebo group of the Phase III trial.
